plan.title: Jev advisory semantic review of xBRIEF acceptance criteria at pan plan finalize (warnings only)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 14 files in four real areas (src/lib/jev, src/cli plan-finalize, evals, docs). The projected-surface lint counts 9 subsystems only because single files at a repo root each count as one (evals/jev-acceptance-criteria.eval.ts, evals/README.md, docs/XBRIEF.md, configuration/jev.mdx). The disclosure text must ship with the feature it discloses, so splitting into sibling issues would ship an undisclosed data flow or a disclosure for a feature that does not exist.

narratives.Problem: lintItem in src/lib/xbrief/quality-lint.ts flags ac-not-observable when an AC title contains none of the 49 OBSERVABLE_TERMS substrings. 'Given the page loads then it works' passes and 'The CLI exit code is 2 on a missing file' fails, so planners add magic words instead of writing testable criteria. Nothing detects an AC that packs several behaviors into one line.
narratives.Proposal: Add reviewAcceptanceCriteria(doc) in src/lib/jev/acceptance-criteria.ts. It sends one assess('jevAcceptanceCriteriaReview', ...) request per plan with two Nouls per non-cancelled AC (observable_<id>, compound_<id>) and returns warn-only QualityIssues ac-semantic-not-observable and ac-semantic-compound, thresholds in src/lib/jev/questions.ts. pan plan finalize calls it after the keyword quality gate passes and merges its warnings into the existing warnings block; the exit code never changes. An answered review appends ids and Nouls (no AC text) to a local shadow eval log. An evalite eval with 60+ labeled ACs from .pan/specs measures agreement. The keyword rule stays the gate; quality-lint.ts and planning-promotion.ts are untouched. Full brief: .pan/drafts/PAN-4372.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing, removing or relaxing the keyword rule ac-not-observable or OBSERVABLE_TERMS; src/lib/xbrief/quality-lint.ts gets zero diff lines
- Making any Jev result an error, or letting any Jev outcome change the pan plan finalize exit code
- Calling Jev from lintPlanQuality, assertPlanQuality, src/lib/overdeck/planning-promotion.ts, the dashboard complete-planning route or the Deacon
- Calling createJevClient directly from production code (only assess(); the eval is the one exception, as in evals/jev-smoke.eval.ts)
- Any hardcoded or fallback Jev model id
- Reading the shadow eval log back for any decision
- Writing AC title text to the shadow eval log
- Positional question keys (follow-up only if the live eval proves dotted keys are rejected)
- Tuning thresholds beyond the 0.5 defaults
- Settings UI changes beyond the toggle description string
- Any output change when Jev is unavailable (no jev block, toggle off, or cheap mode)

autoDecisions.summary: State is { criteria: { "<acId>": "<title>" } } (object keyed by AC id, plan order) rather than an array of {id,title}.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue writes the question as criteria[<id>]; an object keyed by id carries the same id and title data and makes the question text resolve literally.

autoDecisions.summary: Question keys use the raw AC id (observable_<acId>, compound_<acId>), including dotted ids like foo.ac2.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's acceptance criterion naming (observable_ac1). SDK types allow any string key; if the server rejects dots the result is a visible failed/bad-request line, harmless, and the eval exercises real dotted ids to find out.

autoDecisions.summary: Thresholds JEV_AC_OBSERVABLE_MIN_NOUL = 0.5 (warn below) and JEV_AC_COMPOUND_MAX_NOUL = 0.5 (warn above) in questions.ts; QUESTION_SET_VERSION bumped to origin/main + 1.
autoDecisions.rationale: Neutral starting point matching JEV_SMOKE_NOUL_THRESHOLD; the eval and shadow log exist to tune them. The version bump is required by the memo-key contract in questions.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: --no-quality-lint also skips the Jev review; a failing keyword gate exits 3 before any Jev call.
autoDecisions.rationale: No gate ran, so there is nothing to advise on; and the issue requires assertPlanQuality behavior to be independent of Jev.

autoDecisions.summary: failed prints exactly one dim stderr line 'Jev acceptance-criteria review did not run (<reason>)' in text mode; unavailable and skipped print nothing; --json prints nothing extra.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue pins only the unavailable case as unchanged. An operator who enabled the toggle should learn when it breaks; one who did not must see no change.

autoDecisions.summary: Semantic warnings merge into the existing '⚠ xBRIEF quality warnings:' block and the qualityWarnings JSON stderr line.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps one output shape; formatQualityIssues already renders '[warn] <rule>: <message>', which is exactly what the issue's acceptance criterion checks for.

autoDecisions.summary: Shadow log path is ~/.overdeck/jev/eval-log/acceptance-criteria/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl (via getOverdeckHome()), written in a separate module src/lib/jev/eval-log.ts, ids and Nouls only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the rag-runs append-only JSONL pattern; keeping AC text out limits what persists locally; a separate module keeps its tests independent.

autoDecisions.summary: The fixture-count requirement (60+ ACs) is checked by a node -e verify command, not a new unit test.
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo lint rejects new tests that read files to grep them; a verify command gives the same mechanical check.

autoDecisions.summary: plan.metadata.sizeJustification set instead of splitting into sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The 9-subsystem count is an artifact of single root files; the disclosure text must land with the feature.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1. In src/lib/jev/questions.ts add JEV_AC_OBSERVABLE_MIN_NOUL = 0.5, JEV_AC_COMPOUND_MAX_NOUL = 0.5 and acceptanceCriteriaQuestions(acIds) building observable_<id> and compound_<id> Nouls with the exact PRD D2 texts; set QUESTION_SET_VERSION to origin/main's value + 1. Create src/lib/jev/acceptance-criteria.ts exporting buildAcceptanceCriteriaRequest(doc) (non-cancelled items only, ACs via subItemsOf filtered on metadata.kind acceptance_criterion, first duplicate id wins, state { criteria: { [acId]: title } }) and async reviewAcceptanceCriteria(doc, options) that returns skipped with no call when there are zero ACs, otherwise calls assess('jevAcceptanceCriteriaReview', state, questions, options) exactly once and maps answered Nouls to warn-severity QualityIssues ac-semantic-not-observable (noul < 0.5) and ac-semantic-compound (noul > 0.5) with itemId = parent item id and the PRD message format; unavailable/failed return zero issues. Never call createJevClient. Write the 5 named tests from the PRD using the client.test.ts harness (cost-events mock, resetJevMemo in beforeEach, injected config, fake fetch, evalLogHome in a mkdtemp dir). Answers are a NoulResponse|ScoreResponse|ChoiceResponse union under the wide Questions type, so narrow before reading: const a = answers[key]; const n = a?.type === 'noul' ? a.noul : null; a null answer produces no issue.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3. In src/cli/commands/plan-finalize.ts, inside the else branch after the !qualityGate.ok early return (grep anchor: const warnings = qualityGate.issues.filter), await reviewAcceptanceCriteria(planDoc) once, merge its issues after the keyword warnings into the same warnings array so the existing text block and the --json qualityWarnings stderr line print them, and when the review status is failed and not --json print exactly one chalk.dim stderr line 'ℹ Jev acceptance-criteria review did not run (<reason>)'. Do not touch evaluatePlanFinalizeQualityGate, the exit codes, quality-lint.ts or planning-promotion.ts. Create tests/unit/cli/plan-finalize-jev-review.test.ts with the PRD harness (vi.mock of src/cli/exit.js recording codes, src/lib/activity-logger.js, src/lib/projects.js and src/lib/jev/client.js assess; OVERDECK_HOME stubbed to a mkdtemp dir; a feature-pan-9999 workspace with a lint-clean .overdeck/spec.vbrief.json whose AC id is ac1 and a 20+ line .pan/drafts/PAN-9999.md; planFinalizeCommand({ workspace, promote: false })) and the 5 named tests. Fixture recipe (PRD WI-3): copy the ac()/item()/doc() helper shapes from src/lib/xbrief/__tests__/quality-lint.test.ts lines 11-62 (not makeDoc() from plan-finalize-report.test.ts, which is not lint-clean); one item with kind backend, readiness sequential, requiresInspection false, files_scope ['src/item-1.ts'], files_scope_confidence high, an 8+ word Action, and exactly two ACs ac1 'Given a valid request then it returns success' and ac2 'The command rejects invalid requests with a clear error'; plan.metadata.docsJustification set.
